o #1236 issuecomment-7182681531, bo sung cho luat danh sach cho phep (issuecomment-7180063460).

    mot tep thuong va lot. He qua co chu dich: `./x`, `a//b`, `sub/../x` cung bi chan;
(c) duong dan dich sau chuan hoa trung tung byte mot tep thuong cua danh muc (nhu luot 5).
Con lai tra kiem_tep:not_measured:symlink (rc 12) ma khong goi module.

ban dich) cho dich hong khong chuan tac. Dot bien moi: bo_cam_cheo, cam_cheo_chi_dich_tho,
